blocks.title: A Look Back
body: At the second semesterly Student Mental Health Hub Open House, students explored the space & learned how to get involved in peer support!

topics.text: A therapy-dog visit was part of the Open House.
Button and ribbon making were among the activities.
The event offered cow and cheese stress toys, mini ducks, and Snoopy stickers.
A communal art activity was offered.
Resource Referral Cards and Navigating Housing in Madison toolkit materials were available.
Visitors could learn about Badger Supports, the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention, and ways to get involved.
